decision.headline: Make the **peanut butter** sandwich: two of four would rather eat it, one has no preference, and nobody picked the jelly.
decision.detail: Everyone who tasted peanut butter rated it Good or Great. Jelly was rated Good by two of the three who tried it and Fair by one, and it was the only sandwich anyone called Some work.

checks.label: More people would rather eat it
Most people do not rate its effort A chore

conditions: Wholemeal bread, made at home at lunch
limits: Four people choosing a lunch describe those four and nobody else.
Dee did not make or taste the jelly sandwich, so her ratings are missing, not low.
changes: Someone at the table who cannot eat peanuts
